description: A stream of what happens on this node. It opens with a snapshot of every job, the newest news of each of the node's own jobs, and the file tree as one command per entry ending in treeComplete, then sends every event as it happens, each with its kind: job-updated, job-deleted, relay-event, packet and contact.rename. In a quiet second it sends a beat. A page is handed the packets waiting and marks them taken; a process that says it is one only sees each new packet and takes none. Owner only.
